_notes: GOLDEN FORFEIT GAMEWEEK — cross-engine contract for spec §8a (owner
Option B). Every expected number below was computed BY HAND from
FantasyConfig.futsalDefault() (spec §7) BEFORE either pipeline ran.
Replayed by test/fantasy/golden_forfeit_test.dart (Dart, the reference)
and functions/src/lib/fantasy/golden_forfeit_replay.test.ts (TS port).
Never copy actual values in here — if an engine disagrees, it is wrong.
RULE: forfeitedBy 1|2 on the game node. The team that SHOWED UP: each
PRESENT player gets ONLY the +1 appearance (no clean sheet, no stat
points, no bonus); absent players 0. The FORFEITING team: 0, no
appearance, no goals-conceded penalty, and they did NOT play (played =
false -> auto-subs cover them, the vice takes the armband). Events
recorded on a forfeited game are ignored entirely, and a forfeited game
puts 0 into BPS for EVERYONE, so it awards no 3/2/1 bonus.
GAME 0 — Lions 5-0 Tigers, forfeitedBy 2 (Tigers forfeited). Stray
events recorded anyway: Lions Goal Leo + Assist Lara + Goal Gus (Gus is
on no roster), Tigers Save Tom x2 + Yellow Theo — ALL ignored. The
attendance field is the finalizer's roster-composed map: Lena absent.
Mapper: Lions (won) Luca/Lara/Leo present, Lena absent; Tigers (lost)
Tom/Tess/Theo present. Gus is NOT in the output (activity is never read
on a forfeit; the player set is the attendance keys).
Base: Luca 1, Lara 1, Leo 1 (stray goal ignored; without the rule he'd
have 1+4+CS2 = 7), Lena 0 (absent), Tom 0, Tess 0, Theo 0 (no -1
conceded, no appearance). BPS all 0 (without the rule Luca would carry
CS 5, Leo 12+5 ...) -> bonus {}.
GAME 1 — Hawks 2-1 Foxes, normal (no marker).
Hal  GK  saves2 conc1:     1 + floor(2/2)*1                = 2   BPS 2*2 = 4
Hana DEF goal1 assist1 c1: 1 + 6 + 4                       = 11  BPS 12+9 = 21
Hugo ATT goal1 c1:         1 + 4                           = 5   BPS 12
Finn GK  saves3 conc2:     1 + floor(3/2)*1 - floor(2/2)*1 = 1   BPS 3*2 = 6
Faye DEF assist1 yellow1 c2: 1 + 4 - 1 - floor(2/2)*1      = 3   BPS 9-4 = 5
Fred ATT goal1 c2:         1 + 4 (ATT never docked)        = 5   BPS 12
Bonus: Hana 21 -> 3; Hugo 12 = Fred 12 tie -> both 2, the tie consumes
slots 2 AND 3, so nobody gets 1.
